Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City wwwdilq.qov.ph JUN 1 1 2025 OPINION NO. ENGR. ALDRIANE D.C. IGNA City Mayor City of La Carlota Negros Occidental Dear Engr. Igna: This has reference to your letter dated 16 December 2024 seeking this Department's guidance and legal opinion on the jurisdiction of the barangay by virtue of the Katarungang Pambarangay and/or Republic Act No. 7160, otherwise known as the Local Government Code. Per your representation, you are planning to file a complaint arising from a Contract of Loan where you as the complainant is residing in Baliwag Bulacan, while the respondent is a resident of Barangay Pinagbakahan, Malolos, Bulacan. You represented that you are constrained to file before the Katarungang Pambarangay before elevating the matter to the court of competent jurisdiction for Small Claims case, considering that a barangay conciliation is a condition precedent in filing a complaint before the courts. Thus, the request for legal opinion on the proper venue in filing such complaint. At the onset, Section 408 (f) provides that disputes involving parties who actually reside in barangays of different cities or municipalities, except where such barangay units adjoin each other and the parties thereto agree to submit their differences to amicable settlement by an appropriate lupon, is not subject to amicable settlement under the Katarungang Pambarangay. In this case, since you and the respondent reside in barangays situated in different municipalities that are not adjacent to each other, the dispute does not fall within the jurisdiction of the Katarungang Pambarangay for amicable settlement. Consequently, you may directly file the case before the court of competent jurisdiction. This opinion is based solely on the facts and representations you have narrated in your letter and our appreciation of the same. We hope to have addressed your concern accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: IZ-ß—zJ ATTY. ROMEO P.
